notes: Database file shrink: the base64-to-file migration now completes in a single startup (previously 500 rows per restart), and a one-time VACUUM reclaims the space freed by migrated images, shrinking a bloated database file (e.g. 2 GB) down to its real data size. Also adds an optional request log (REQUEST_LOG=1) that records method, path, status, duration and client IP only, never request bodies.
